name: IREN
description: IREN rents out AI computing: it builds and owns the data centers (land, grid power, buildings, cooling), fills them with GPUs and sells dedicated GPU capacity, mostly under multi-year reserved contracts, to Microsoft, NVIDIA, AI labs and enterprises. It is mid-way through changing what it is. Until 2025 almost all revenue came from mining bitcoin in its own data centers; in the fiscal year to June 2026 mining was still 82 percent of the $707 million of revenue, but the June 2026 quarter was the first where AI cloud ($70.5M) out-earned mining ($66.7M), and management is stripping out the miners to reuse the power for GPUs by December 31, 2026. Contracted AI cloud value is far larger than current sales: $5.1 billion of remaining performance obligations plus $11.4 billion of contracted lease value at June 30, 2026, including a roughly $9.7 billion five-year Microsoft contract and a $3.4 billion NVIDIA contract. The cost of that build is heavy: a $702.6 million net loss in FY2026 after $638.8 million of impairments (mostly bitcoin mining hardware), about $6.7 billion of convertible notes and a $3.6 billion GPU financing, funded alongside customer prepayments and a continuing share-sale programme.

sub.name: Crypto exchanges, miners and bitcoin holders

hq.note: Level 5, 55 Market Street, Sydney NSW 2000 (FY2026 10-K cover); incorporated in Australia. Operating assets are mostly in Texas (Childress, Sweetwater), British Columbia, plus Oklahoma, Spain and South Australia sites in development; 72% of non-current assets in the US and 24% in Canada at FY2026 year end.

employees.note: 685 employees globally (FY2026 10-K Item 1); about 580 more joined with the Mirantis acquisition in August 2026; about 3,000 contractor and subcontractor personnel on US sites at 2026-06-30.

businessLines.name: AI Cloud Services
businessLines.how: Customers sign three-to-five-year reserved-capacity contracts for a fixed amount and type of GPU capacity at a contracted price, often with 20 percent or more prepaid, and pay monthly once the cluster is delivered and accepted; revenue does not start until acceptance. On-demand, usage-based service is planned to complement this over time. IREN buys the GPUs and funds them with customer prepayments plus asset-level debt tied to the contract.
businessLines.description: Dedicated GPU computing (bare metal and managed cloud) for AI training and inference, delivered from IREN-owned data centers in British Columbia (revenue to date) and Childress, Texas (Microsoft Horizon 1-4). Customers: hyperscalers, frontier labs, AI developers, enterprises and channel partners. About 40 MW of operating AI capacity at 2026-06-30. GPUs installed or on order: AMD MI350X and NVIDIA H100, H200, B200, B300, GB300, VR200. Software layer added by the Mirantis acquisition (completed August 2026, after year end).

operatingProfit.note: Share is of total segment gross profit $487.301M. No segment operating profit after depreciation is disclosed.

businessLines.name: Bitcoin Mining
businessLines.how: Block rewards (3.125 BTC per block since the April 2024 halving) plus transaction fees, paid by the Bitcoin network through the mining pool in proportion to IREN's share of global hashrate, sold for USD or CAD every day; revenue moves with bitcoin price and network hashrate, and cost is mostly electricity.
businessLines.description: Mines bitcoin with owned ASIC miners in IREN data centers, joining third-party mining pools (Antpool and Foundry named as the main pools) and selling the coin daily; no bitcoin held at 2026-06-30. In wind-down: decommissioning started in FY2026, power and space are being re-assigned to AI Cloud with the transition to be substantially complete by 2026-12-31, and no further material miner purchases are planned.

operatingProfit.note: Mining hardware drove most of the $638.8M FY2026 impairment charge, which sits outside segment gross profit.

brands.name: IREN AI Cloud (own data centers and GPUs)
brands.share: 18.2% of FY2026 revenue; 51.4% of June 2026 quarter revenue

brands.name: Mirantis (acquired; k0rdent AI orchestration software, Kubernetes services)
brands.share: Not in FY2026 results: acquired 2026-08-03 or 08-04 (10-K gives both dates) for about $544M (12.6M IREN shares plus about $40M cash and RSUs); about 580 staff and more than 1,500 enterprise customers

brands.name: Nostrum Group (Ingenostrum S.L., Spain, grid-connected data center developer)
brands.share: No revenue; acquired June 2026 for 837,424 IREN shares plus about EUR 82M cash; adds the 300 MW Badajoz site and more than 60 staff

whatsNext.text: Microsoft Horizon 2, 3 and 4 GPU halls at Childress targeted for phased delivery in calendar Q4 2026, with contractual grace periods running from mid-Q4 2026 to the start of Q2 2027; Horizon 1 was accepted in August 2026
Substantially complete the removal of bitcoin miners and reuse of that power for AI Cloud by 2026-12-31
Reach $4bn of contracted ARR operational by 2026-12-31 (from about $1bn operating on 2026-08-26); company internal assumptions
Cumulative deliveries of about 0.3 GW (IT) in 2026 and 0.8 GW (IT) in 2027; new liquid-cooled deployments at Mackenzie, Canal Flats and Prince George during 2027
